#### `ore_block` {#ore_block}

<p class="fl-facts">required · block</p>

**The block that replaces some of the fossil's bones.**

Roughly one bone in ten becomes this, which is what makes a fossil worth digging out. The rest stay bone.

#### `max_empty_corners` {#max_empty_corners}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer</p>

**How much of the fossil may stick out into open space before the placement is refused.**

Counted over the corners of the chosen structure's box. Raising it lets fossils appear in caves and cliffsides rather than only fully buried.
